notes.text: Eruvin 60a follows ס. under the period convention. Earlier machine OCR used a comma after ס; the supplied period governs this rendering, without independent edition-specific verification.
Popidta is a conventional vocalization of פופידתא. Mar is explicit in מר בר פופידתא; the name listing supplies no further identification.
